summary: This node says that for all large k no C(n,k) with 2k <= n < k^2 has every prime factor above k. With g(k) the least n > k+1 for which every prime factor of C(n,k) exceeds k, that is the statement g(k) > k^2 for all large k (n >= 2k > k+1 once k >= 2). Konyagin (1999) proved g(k) >> exp(c (log k)^2) = k^(c log k), which exceeds k^2 for large k, so the statement is a published theorem, by analytic methods (fractional parts of smooth functions) that nobody has formalised. The inference from Konyagin's bound to this node is mine; I read the bound on erdosproblems.com, not in the paper, and the implied constants may be ineffective, which an existence statement does not mind. Note that the child erdos-1094--h3--h1 (the last-digit residue form) is stronger and is NOT covered by this record.
